Routes that have CF-native handlers:
- adapters (GET), plugins (multiple), company-access (join-requests, user-directory), company-skills (GET), events (ws)

Routes that are NOT in either category (will return 501):
- healthRoutes (GET /api/health)
- companySkillRoutes 
- pluginRoutes
- pluginUiStaticRoutes
- instanceDatabaseBackupRoutes
- Other unmounted routes
